title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Discount Stacking Basis for Courtesy and Member Discounts
content:
## Clauses in force

1. The courtesy discount program and the member repair discount never stack on the same invoice line of a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls.
2. The courtesy discount is taken only on a repair parts, repair labor or paid tune-up line that receives no member repair discount. Where the courtesy percentage is higher than the member percentage, it is taken in place of the member discount on that line.
3. Enrollment in a courtesy program (senior 65 plus, military veteran or first responder) is read from the customer's profile.
4. The courtesy discount applies only in classes where the courtesy program applies. It never applies to diagnostic fees, premiums, refrigerant, trip fees, cancellation fees or late-payment charges.
5. Discounts are taken on the line's charged amount and rounded per line to the cent half up.
6. Coverage credits are applied only after every discount on that line.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The former clause under which a customer enrolled in a courtesy program (senior 65 plus, military veteran or first responder on the profile) received the class's courtesy program percentage as a courtesy discount line is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current courtesy discount basis.
- The former ceiling under which a line's discounts and coverage together never exceeded its charged amount is no longer in force as a clause of this basis.

## Which discount a line carries (hypothetical percentages)

| Line | Member repair discount on the line | Courtesy percentage compared with member percentage | Discount the line carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| Repair labor, customer not a member | None | — | Courtesy discount |
| Repair parts, member at 15 percent | 15 percent | Courtesy 10 percent is lower | Member discount only |
| Repair labor, member at 5 percent | 5 percent | Courtesy 10 percent is higher | Courtesy discount in place of the member discount |
| Diagnostic fee | — | — | No courtesy discount |
| Refrigerant | — | — | No courtesy discount |

## Rounding illustration (hypothetical)

A repair labor line of $483.75 for a courtesy customer with no member discount takes 10 percent of $483.75, which is $48.375 and rounds half up to $48.38. Any coverage credit on that line is applied only after this discount.
